call.text: The decoder stack adds a third sub‑layer that performs multi‑head attention over the encoder’s output, whereas the encoder stack contains only self‑attention sub‑layers that attend to its own previous layer outputs [AIAYN:3.1:c009][AIAYN:3.2.3:c016]. In the encoder‑decoder attention, the queries are taken from the preceding decoder layer, while the keys and values are taken from the encoder’s output representations [AIAYN:3.2.3:c016]. The decoder also masks its self‑attention to prevent positions from attending to subsequent positions, preserving the auto‑regressive property [AIAYN:3.2.3:c016][AIAYN:3.1:c009]. The encoder’s self‑attention uses the same source for queries, keys, and values—the output of its previous encoder layer [AIAYN:3.2.3:c016]. The retrieved passages do not state any additional architectural differences beyond these points.
